reviews.notes: Severe contamination: only ~22 of 98 rows are genuinely maritime. Kept the real core — deck/crew (sailor, ordinary seaman, matrose, decksman, boatswain, engine minder, fisheries deckhand), officers (officer of the watch, helmsman, deck officer, skipper, ship captain, maritime pilot), marine engineering (marine engineer, marine chief engineer, ship duty engineer, ship assistant engineer, fisheries engineering technician), and offshore renewable energy engineer (marine/offshore, retained). Removed 5 aka=NaN SOC group-label junk rows and a very large generic-engineering fan-out: ISCO 2149 (~39 roles), 2144 mechanical (~15), 2141 industrial/production (~11), and a 3117 mining/metallurgy/water-tech technician cluster (~5) — all cross-domain contamination. The three commercial-diving roles (7541) are underwater work adjacent to maritime; flagged as overfanout (arguably a Diving/Underwater domain) but retained. Added naval architect and VTS operator to fill genuine maritime gaps.
